expectations.text: explains_clip_placement: Explica o muestra correctamente el ClipRRect dentro del Hero para interpolar border radius
expectations.evidence: The response uses flightShuttleBuilder to animate ClipRRect border radius during flight, which is technically valid, but never explains the critical rule about ClipRRect placement (inside vs outside the Hero child). The summary only says 'flightShuttleBuilder es el lugar correcto para interpolar propiedades visuales durante el vuelo' without addressing why placing ClipRRect outside the Hero child causes a flash or incorrect clipping.
